description: Update masked integration configuration for one job: enabled=true with externalProjectId maps/activates the provider project without inviting any hires; assign the returned setupTodo.itemId through opentrain_manage_project_todo action=assign. enabled=false disables the mapping and archives the setup obligation while retaining history. Credential connect/disconnect stays in the web app; no secret material is accepted or returned. Requires integrations:write scope and employer provider access.

enabled.description: true maps/activates the provider project; false disables the mapping.

externalProjectId.description: Required when enabling: the provider-side project id to map.

name: opentrain_update_integration_config
